goal: Allow wallets and external services to query chain state and receive notifications over IPC
Eliminate the need for out-of-process tools to poll JSON-RPC
reviewability: Ready to review now as branch merges cleanly and CI passes
agreement: Strong concept support and downstream integration testing with open input-validation concerns
Verified by testing against Rust wallet clients on regtest and signet (darosior, sedited)
Demonstrated through prototype integration with Electrs (Sjors)
Unaddressed objection: node aborts when requested block height exceeds active chain tip (zaidmstrr)
Nonblocking objection: node may crash if clients omit required parameters (willcl-ark)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it provides a foundational interface for process separation
Unblocks running the wallet out of process
Lets external services interact with chain state without polling RPC
